run.userPrompt:
In 2026, an adaptive-learning startup is expanding from the US into Vietnam, Saudi Arabia, France, and Kenya. Each country mandates different curricula, language-of-instruction rules, and attitudes toward foreign educational content; parents and teachers hold different beliefs about screen time and standardized testing; and government procurement processes differ from direct-to-consumer purchasing.

Design a product strategy for localizing an adaptive-learning platform across countries with mandated curricula, different parental attitudes, and mixed procurement channels, balancing a shared technology core against local fit.
